title: Jazzy Snappy Peruvian Potato Papas a la Huancaina
description: A comforting and snappy Peruvian dish featuring oyster sauce, ideal for a quick and flavorful meal.
instructions: Boil the potatoes in a large pot of salted water for 10 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and let them cool to room temperature.
Meanwhile, in a blender, combine the red onion, tomatoes, serrano pepper, oyster sauce, green chili paste, Peruvian aji amarillo paste, salt, and black pepper.
Blend the mixture until smooth and adjust the seasoning as needed.
In a large pressure cooker, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the blended mixture and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the potatoes, cheddar cheese, queso fresco, and cilantro to the pressure cooker.
Stir to combine and cook for 5 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Remove the pressure cooker from the heat and stir in the lime juice.
Serve the Papas a la Huancaina hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
